theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x (w x)) U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (w z)) x e P = a x (fderiv ℝ w x e) P + fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (w x) P) x e
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
